dog.description_text:
This pet needs emergency placement. Please click here to go to our emergency placement page for more information.

This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Travis is at risk due to behavioral reasons. Travis has been observed to be highly rope reactive and fearful while in care. Noted to bite and tug the leash into kennel when handlers are attempting to leash him. This behavior is not able to be redirected using treats or squeaky sounds. When handlers attempt to interact with Travis in kennel he is noted to rush to the front of the kennel with a tense body. During intake Travis allowed all handling with a wagging tail. Medically, Travis has allergies, otitis chronic, and a wound.

Travis arrived at MACC as a stray with no known history. While in care, Travis has been observed to be fearful and highly rope reactive. Noted to rush to the front of the kennel with a tense body and hard bark when a handler attempts to interact. Travis will also bite and tug the leash into kennel when handlers are attempting to leash him. Due to the detailed behavior, we recommend an experienced adult-only home.
dog.name: Travis
